name: chatgpt-assistant-overlay
description: A Windows local development worker bridged to the user's existing ChatGPT conversation through a shared GitHub repository mailbox.

scripts.check: node --check desktop/prepare-gh-cli.js && node --check desktop/main.js && node --check desktop/preload.js && node --check desktop/renderer.js && node --check desktop/geometry.js && node --check desktop/workspace-path.js && node --check desktop/filesystem-index.js && node --check desktop/tool-runner.js && node --check desktop/github-auth.js && node --check desktop/tool-bridge.js && node --check desktop/vision-service.js && node --check desktop/repository-bridge.js && node --check test/geometry.test.js && node --check test/workspace-path.test.js && node --check test/filesystem-index.test.js && node --check test/app-contract.test.js && node --check test/tool-runner.test.js && node --check test/tool-bridge.test.js && node --check test/vision-service.test.js && node --check test/github-auth.test.js && node --check test/repository-bridge.test.js && node -e "const n=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vision/vision_worker.ipynb','utf8')); for(const c of n.cells||[]) if(c.cell_type==='code' && !Array.isArray(c.source)) throw Error('Malformed notebook source'); console.log('Notebook JSON and source cells: OK')"
